title: Add GitHub-flavored technical writing to Survey

decidedForYou.question: When does the Survey pass run?

options.label: After the queue switch
options.consequence: The queue round never waits on a Survey release. The queue ships its copy of the document styles, and a later dependency update swaps in Survey's file.

options.label: Before the queue's page pass, so the queue takes the styles from Survey from the start
options.consequence: The queue's third pass would wait for your approve of a Survey release in the middle of an unattended round.

evidence.text: The design's round section and its first call.

decidedForYou.question: Does a design fold its technical notes?

options.label: Yes, once the new queue is the one you read in
options.consequence: A design's reference sections take one line each until you open them. The headings stay in the "On this page" list.

options.label: No, every section stays open
options.consequence: The long test page stays about two screens longer.

evidence.text: You said "Excellent, continue" to the suggestion on 2026-11-12. Reading that as a yes to folding is Claude's.

decidedForYou.applied: Yes, once the new queue is the one you read in

decidedForYou.question: How deep do headings go in a document?

options.label: A title and three levels below it
options.consequence: A writer who needs a fifth level splits the section. The page still draws six, for a document that arrives with them.

options.label: Six levels, as the page can draw
options.consequence: Deep nesting that a reader can't follow in the list of headings.

evidence.text: Butterick advises three levels at most; the title makes the fourth.

decidedForYou.applied: A title and three levels below it

steps.text: Nothing starts until you approve the queue switch.
One pass, launched from `plans/sv-s1-planning-prompt.txt`, writes the writing file and the stylesheet in Survey and opens the release: a Survey pull request and a workstation pull request.
Read one document in the new queue. Approving it merges both pull requests and publishes Survey 1.8.0.

notChecked.text: No fresh reader has checked this design against Survey's code.
Google's rules for headings, lists, and tables were not read again for this design. The pass reads them before it writes a rule that cites them.
Vale has not read this design. `tellgrader` under the docs register reports nothing.
Whether Survey's repo can render the specimen for the visual comparison with what it has installed. How the pass renders it is left to the builder.
